T03 with a year-only founding date. A agreed; ignore if A already relayed this. When Crustdata gives only year_founded (no month or day), T03 should support only when the first invoice is clearly before the founding, i.e. dated before 1 Jan of that year. Never support on "founded within new_vendor_days of the first invoice", because a year-only date cannot place the founding within days.
Examples:
- founded 2026, first V017 invoice 2026-03 -> no support
- founded 2026, first invoice 2025-06 -> supports, as now
Vendor-master created_on (day level) keeps the current rule. Please add a unit test for both examples.
Why: career_overlap's shell_company V017 must stop being Substantiated. Today it rests on T03 (timing) + T17 (identity). b1 is moving V017's invoices to 2026-03 onward, but with year-only 2026 read as 2026-01-01, T03 would still fire through new_vendor_days. Reply with the commit hash.

Thanks: T03 (bc6521f) and bears_on (ea10372) noted. Both of your pipeline asks are good and I'll do them right after a3's README eval, so the table comes from one stable commit: (1) widen tests_to_run with rules.tests_for(h.typology); (2) dedupe the T16 path exhibits by (staff, vendor). I'll reply with the commit hash and ask a3 for a follow-up eval.
ack: README eval (6x3, cold Crustdata cache) starting now on main. Your tests_to_run widening and T16 dedupe go to a1 after this run.
